# League Match — How It Works

A league match is your main competitive event. Two team managers face off in a ball-by-ball cricket simulation. Understanding the three phases — Scheduled, Live, and Completed — will help you win more matches.

## Scheduled State

Before the match goes live, both teams must prepare and signal they are ready.

### Getting Ready
- Open the match and tap the **Ready** button to confirm your squad.
- Both teams must be ready before the toss can happen.
- Use **Match Preparation** (available from the pre-match screen) to apply a **Focus Boost** — this temporarily raises your players' levels for the upcoming match. It is worth doing before every important game.

### The Toss
- Once both teams are ready, the toss runs automatically.
- The toss winner gets to choose whether to **Bat** or **Bowl** first.
- Choose based on pitch conditions and your squad strengths — pace-heavy teams often prefer bowling on bouncy pitches.

## Live State — Ball by Ball

When the match goes live you see the field, the spinner, and the scoreboard.

### The Spinner
- The **batting team's manager** controls the spinner.
- Tap the **Spin** button (or press **Spacebar** on desktop) to deliver the next ball.
- The wheel spins and decelerates to land on an outcome — runs, dot ball, wicket, wide, or no-ball.
- You can also press **Fast Play** to skip the deceleration animation.

### Batting Team Controls
- **Play Style:** Before each ball you can switch between **Conservative**, **Standard**, and **Aggressive**.
  - Conservative gives more dots but fewer wickets — good for protecting a small lead.
  - Standard is the balanced default.
  - Aggressive increases both big-shot potential and wicket risk — best when chasing large totals.
- **Probability Meter:** Shows the likelihood of each outcome (runs, dot, wicket) for the current matchup. Use it to decide your play style for that ball.
- When a wicket falls you must pick the **next batsman** from your squad.

### Bowling Team Controls
- The bowling team's manager selects the **bowler** at the start of each new over.
- You can also open **Field Setup** to change your fielding position preset for the current phase of play — this influences the probability of run outcomes.

### Scoreboard & Commentary
- The live scoreboard shows the current score, over, run rate, and required rate (second innings).
- Ball-by-ball commentary updates after every delivery.
- Tap the **Scorecard** tab to view the full batting and bowling breakdown at any time.

## Match Tabs

The drawer at the bottom gives you several views during and after the match.

- **Live** — The active play area with spinner, controls, and scoreboard.
- **Scorecard** — Batting and bowling innings tables for both teams.
- **Graphs** — Run rate graph plotted over overs.
- **History** — Full ball-by-ball log of every delivery.
- **Info** — Match metadata, head-to-head stats, and team details.

## Autoplay

Autoplay is a bot that plays on behalf of a team when that team's manager is offline.

- If **you** go offline mid-match, the bot will take over and continue playing for your team at a balanced level.
- If your **opponent** is offline, the bot plays for them — you still control your own team normally.
- **Simulation Mode:** When both managers belong to the same user (i.e. you own both teams), the match runs in full simulation — both sides are automated. You can watch the match unfold or switch to Fast Play.

## Match Room

- Tap the **Users** icon in the top-right corner to open the Match Room — a live chat and presence panel.
- You can see who else is watching the match and send messages.
- A preview toast appears at the top when a new message arrives without the room open.

## Expert Tips

### Pitch Types
- **Batting pitches:** High-scoring surfaces — favour aggressive batting styles.
- **Bowling pitches:** More swing and seam — consider bowling first and exploiting early wickets.
- **Spin-friendly surfaces:** Spin bowlers get extra movement — prioritise leg spinners and off-spinners in your playing XI.

### Strategy
1. Check your **Playing XI** before going ready — confirm bowling order is complete.
2. Use **Focus Boost** in Match Preparation before every match; the level increase is significant.
3. In the first innings, bat **Standard** early, switch to **Aggressive** in overs 7–10 for a late surge.
4. Defending a total: use **Conservative** with your best death bowlers in the final two overs.
5. Chasing a big target: go **Aggressive** from over 6 onward, accepting the higher wicket risk.
6. Watch the **Probability Meter** — if the meter shows a high wicket risk, switch to Conservative for one ball to play it safe.
